_comment: Default Fortunate ideal-client questions for the Laya sidecar. No 'labels' = yes/no (Laya 'noul', p = P(yes)). 'labels' = single-choice (Laya 'choice', p = prob of top label). 'multi': true with labels = one yes/no per label (Laya has no native multi-label type).

Is this person mainly a content creator, influencer or UGC creator who makes content for other brands?
Is this an agency, freelancer, consultant or other service provider selling services rather than products?
Is this a supplier, manufacturer, factory or wholesaler that makes products for other brands?
Is this person or business based in the United States or selling to customers in the United States?
Is this person or business based in the Netherlands?
How large does the business appear to be?
